topic_thesis: Financial influencers are not teaching you to trade; they are using your 'education' as a lead-generation funnel to profit from your inevitable brokerage losses.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Conflict of Interest' business model: The influencer earns a kickback (PFOF) from the broker when you sign up, and a fee from you for the course. They win when you trade, not when you profit.
key_statistic: 95% of retail traders lose money, while the influencer earns a guaranteed ₹500-₹1,500 referral fee per account, regardless of your P&L.
pinned_comment_text: Is your 'guru' actually trading, or just living off your referral commissions? Drop your thoughts below, or comment 'GUIDE' to see if your broker is charging you hidden 'education' premiums! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use the hook 'Ungaloda loss-il avanukku commission!' (Your loss is his commission). Use Tanglish terms like 'Trading course scam', 'Brokerage trap', and 'Free seminar, paid loss'. Emphasize that the 'guru' is just an 'Authorized Person' in disguise.
source_signal: Growing retail frustration with Nifty volatility and high-cost 'price action' scams.
